function.description: List Khalani bridge orders for an address with pagination and filters.
function.name: khalani__orders__list

limit.description: Max results. Range 1-20 (provider maximum, default 10); anything else is rejected before the call.

orderIds.description: Comma-separated order IDs to filter. Accepts either a comma-separated string ("1,8453") or an array of strings (["1","8453"]) — the two are equivalent.

txHashSearch.description: Search by transaction hash. At most 66 characters (0x + 64 hex, the provider maximum); a longer value is rejected before the call.

walletAddress.description: Optional. The ACCOUNT address whose orders to list; omit to use your personal wallet. Under a session-scoped wallet it must equal the selected wallet.
